title: Groups targeted by a workload have no members

report.title: {Items.Count} empty {Plural(Items.Count, 'group is', 'groups are')} targeted by policies or applications

messages.businessImpact: Every policy pointing at these groups appears deployed and reaches nothing, which is the most convincing way for a control to be absent.
remediation: Check whether a dynamic rule has stopped matching, which is the usual cause.
Populate the group or retarget the assignments.
messages.cannotSee: A group whose membership this run could not read is passed over rather than reported, so the count here is a floor and not a total. Emptiness is counted across every kind of member, not devices alone, because a group of people holds no devices and reading the two as one figure reported every user group in a tenant as empty. What targets the group is counted from the objects this run read, so a group targeted only by something the run could not see reads as targeted by nothing and is not reported at all. Whether a group is empty on purpose, as a ring waiting to be filled, is not visible.
